yawDeg.description: extra yaw in degrees on top of the forward convention (MODEL_FWD_YAW)

stretch.description: Extra non-uniform scale after height normalize (local axes). Used to stretch bat / crow wings wider without growing body height.

skinned.description: Rigged GLB — keep SkinnedMesh; battle anim is unitAnimated .

bakePose.description: Pose a skinned clip then bake to static meshes for InstancedMesh. `clip`: substring of clip name, or `first` / `longest` / `shortest`. Default time `0` = first frame.

animation.description: Battle animation clips for a rigged model (needs `skinned`).

ModelSpecData.description: A model as authored data — the shape a JSON content file will hold: a file name and degrees instead of a built URL and radians.

range.description: Keep only this time window of the clip (seconds).

clip.description: Which clip: a substring of its name (`"walk"`, `"pitch_baseball"`), `"longest"` / `"shortest"` by duration, or an index.

speed.description: Playback rate (default 1). Higher = less slide on walks, faster long swings.

range.description: Keep only this time window of the clip (seconds).

hold.description: Keep the attack playing even if the mesh moves (crowd jostle / turn). Melee windups need this — by default the attack is dropped as soon as the unit relocates so long attack poses don't stick after the swing.

clip.description: Which clip: a substring of its name (`"walk"`, `"pitch_baseball"`), `"longest"` / `"shortest"` by duration, or an index.

speed.description: Playback rate (default 1). Higher = less slide on walks, faster long swings.

fire.description: One-shot attack; omit if the asset has none.

fallLocal.description: Where the clip lays the body in model XZ (rest forward −Z). Used to turn the body so the fall lines up with the killing blow (ogre `fall`: head travels toward −X, the character's left).

clip.description: Which clip: a substring of its name (`"walk"`, `"pitch_baseball"`), `"longest"` / `"shortest"` by duration, or an index.

speed.description: Playback rate (default 1). Higher = less slide on walks, faster long swings.

death.description: One-shot death / tip-over clip; omit to keep the procedural death tip.

ModelAnimation.description: Battle animation of a rigged GLB (`"animation"` in `assets/data/models/<id>.jsonc`). A model with this block is driven by an AnimationMixer instead of an InstancedMesh; it needs `"skinned": true`.

ClipTimeRange.description: Seconds window inside an authored clip (inclusive start, exclusive-ish end via subclip).

ClipPick.description: Pick a clip when the exporter names them uselessly (NlaTrack / NlaTrack.001). `longest` / `shortest` by duration; or a substring of the clip name; or index.
